title: On the weak operator Daugavet property and poor subspaces
summary: We will provide an example of a Banach space with the Daugavet property which does not possess the weak operator Daugavet property. We will also show that every separable Banach space with the Daugavet property contains a non-poor subspace isomorphic to $\ell^1$ while noticing that every separable subspace of $L^\infty[0,1]$ is poor.
